name: Wayfinder
descr: Play the Wayfinder if you want to hunt your prey and strike with deadly force.

foundations.name: Ruthless Predator
foundations.text: When you make a damage roll, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Additionally, when you deal Severe damage to an adversary, they must mark a Stress.

foundations.name: Path Forward
foundations.text: When you're traveling to a place you've previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

specializations.name: Elusive Predator
specializations.text: When your Focus makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

masteries.name: Apex Predator
masteries.text: Before you make an attack roll against your _Focus_, you can **spend a Hope.** On a successful attack, you remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool.
